svg.text: Raspberry Pi 4 · RC522 · 20×4 I2C LCD (via level converter) · DS3231 RTC · active buzzer · LEDs · shutdown button · fan · Waveshare UPS HAT (D)

g.text: pin 1 = square pad, end nearest the microSD slot
RTC pass-through end (other side of the board)
Waveshare UPS HAT (D) — mounted UNDER the Pi (no wires)
Spring pins press into the underside of the header: 5V (pins 2/4) · GND (6) · SDA (3) · SCL (5)
2 × 21700 cells · charge through the HAT's own USB-C · its ON/OFF switch is the power switch
Battery chip INA219 at 0x43 (+ controller 0x2D) · nothing plugs into the Pi's own USB-C port
Any GND pin works for any ground wire.
Pin 2 feeds three parts (converter HV, LCD, buzzer):
join them with Y-wires or a perfboard strip.
Only the LCD sits on the converter's 5V side;
RTC and UPS stay on the Pi's 3.3V SDA/SCL.
Turn off: hold button 3 s, press again → wait for
'Safe to switch OFF' → switch the UPS off.
Buzzer quiet enough? It may also go straight
